features: ONVIF Profile S and ONVIF Profile G
Maximum frame rate 960 fps across all channels; single channel up to 1080p 120 fps recording
Ethernet failover redundancy or port sharing
Wi-Fi and 4G external USB dongle support (certified brands only)
ARM Cortex A55 8-core CPU; embedded Linux kernel 5.10
Metadata recording: POS, RFID and PIN controller, barcode scanner, GPS, LPR, AI camera, IVS camera
RS-485 keyboard controller port; USB to RS-232 metadata input
P2P app connection by QR code / UID
notes: Maximum network throughput is 300 Mbps, or 160 Mbps with RAID enabled.
eSATA external storage up to 32 TB, 16 TB per connector.
Audio input is one RCA line input plus 32 channels from network cameras; two-way audio is stated for network cameras.
Datasheet video output row reads "25X Optical"; video outputs are taken from the product page and the datasheet feature list.
Product page introduction mentions eight PoE ports; the specification table and datasheet list only two Gigabit Ethernet ports. PoE left out.
